author: ETA PRIME
description:
What happens when you install SteamOS on the most powerful gaming tablet ever made?I took the ASUS ROG Flow Z13 Kojima Productions Cape Edition — powered by the AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 with the Radeon 8060S iGPU and 128GB of unified memory — and completely ditched Windows for official SteamOS 3.9.In this video I test Doom The Dark Ages, Cyberpunk 2077, Elden Ring, God of War Ragnarok, Arc Raiders, Marvel Rivals, and more. Some games actually run BETTER on SteamOS than Windows 11. I also cover TDP tuning, battery life, CSS Loader customization, and everything you need to know before making the switch.
